items.raw_excerpt: 4月7日，扣子宣布2.5版本升级，正式推出AI Agent协作平台Agent World，为AI Agent提供了包含人格、技能、装备三项支撑的“满配”运行基座，新增独立邮箱身份、云手机、云电脑等功能模块，并升级了视频创作Agent等能力。   年初OpenClaw的爆火，成为AI Agent从概念走向全民落地的催化剂。扣子此次升级2.5版本，定位于用户的“满配 AI 伙伴”，旨在探索AI Agent从“工具”到“伙伴”的关键一步。 扣子2.5为AI Agent提供的运行基座包含人格、装备、技能三项支撑，有效拓展了文本对话框和API调用的边界。 “人格”层面，扣子2.5提供了独立邮箱身份和记忆系统。AI Agent可通过独立的邮箱身份实现自主通信交流，和人类用户账号的资源权限互相隔离，更安全便捷。同时，AI Agent可通过长期记忆深刻理解用户的工作习惯与细微偏好。值得注意的是，用户与扣子在飞书、微信、网页等各个渠道的对话相互独立，但各渠道保存的记忆共享，同时严格按Session隔离权限，私聊信息不会泄露到群聊。   “装备”层面，扣子2.5为AI Agent打造了专属工作台。用户在对话中说明任务即可让Agent自动创建日程，还能通过“日历”功能了解Agent工作节奏、创建定时任务、协调Agent状态。此外，用户任务运行中产出的所有数据、图表和业务报告，都会自动分类保存到“文件系统”之中。 扣子2.5中的AI Agent还拥有自己的云电脑和云手机。基于云电脑设备，AI Agent可以在真实的桌面系统中运行代码脚本，像人类一样浏览网页、处理文件，拥有桌面级生产力。而云手机设备预装了Android 13系统，AI Agent可以下载APP，也能直接滑动页面并进行点击操作，其中重要操作仍由人类用户接管。云电脑和云手机均可在后台自动执行任务，直接为用户返回结果。

On April 7, Kousi announced the launch of version 2.5, introducing the AI Agent collaboration platform Agent World. This platform provides a fully equipped operational base for AI Agents, featuring personality, skills, and equipment. It adds new functional modules such as independent email identities, cloud phones, and cloud computers, and upgrades capabilities like video creation Agents. The popularity of OpenClaw earlier this year catalyzed the transition of AI Agents from concept to widespread public use. Kousi's upgrade to version 2.5 positions itself as a "fully equipped AI companion," aiming to bridge the gap between AI Agents as tools and partners. 

The operational base provided by Kousi 2.5 for AI Agents includes three supports: personality, equipment, and skills, effectively expanding the boundaries of text dialogues and API calls. On the "personality" front, Kousi 2.5 offers independent email identities and a memory system. AI Agents can communicate autonomously through their own email identities, with resource permissions isolated from human user accounts, ensuring greater security and convenience. They can also deeply understand users' work habits and subtle preferences through long-term memory. Notably, conversations between users and Kousi across different channels like Feishu, WeChat, and web pages are independent, but the memories saved across channels are shared while strictly isolating permissions by session, ensuring private chat information is not leaked in group chats.

excerpt_i18n.es: El 7 de abril, Kòuzi anunció la actualización a la versión 2.5, lanzando oficialmente la plataforma de colaboración de AI Agent, Agent World. Esta plataforma ofrece un entorno de ejecución completo para los AI Agents, que incluye personalidad, habilidades y equipamiento, además de nuevos módulos funcionales como identidad de correo electrónico independiente, teléfono en la nube y ordenador en la nube. También se han mejorado las capacidades de creación de videos de los AI Agents. El éxito inicial de OpenClaw a principios de este año ha sido un catalizador para que los AI Agents pasen del concepto a una adopción generalizada. Con esta actualización a la versión 2.5, Kòuzi se posiciona como el "compañero AI completo" del usuario, con el objetivo de explorar la transición de los AI Agents de ser "herramientas" a ser "compañeros".

OpenAI has confirmed its participation in the information sharing and accused Chinese company DeepSe in a memo submitted to the US Congress.
